name: Real-jobs harness
description: RealJobs: runs a `Tests/RealJobs/<app>/<job>/` script through the batch runner (ScriptRunner, its report captured) and compares each expected output: sha256 on the whole digest (a pure-Swift SHA-256, FIPS 180-4), JSON parsed and compared equal, or pixels within a tolerance in 255ths. A job whose platforms leave this one out is skipped before it runs with "macOS-only: <why>"; a pixel expectation is skipped "waits on image-codecs" until creative-core can decode PNG, never passed. Prints one JSON report: ok, or the failing paths and why, or skipped and its reason.
